title: problems writing to influxDB
symptom: Writing to InfluxDB on a Raspberry Pi 4 with authentication fails with a NullPointerException about okhttpUrl.host() on a null object reference, despite entering the IP address, port, and auth.
cause: The InfluxDB URI was entered with curly braces around the IP and port (e.g., http://{192.168.1.xxx}:{8086}), which is not a valid URL and causes a parsing problem.
fix: Remove the curly braces from the InfluxDB URI so it is a valid URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.xxx:8086).
evidence_quote: `http://{192.168.1.xxx}:{8086}` is not a valid URL. Please remove the curly brackets (`{`, `}`) and try it again.
